correctness.rationale: For rank r>=2 and corank s=n-r>=2, relaxation at a circuit-hyperplane H introduces a single new basis-graph vertex with neighbors indexed by pairs (h in H,e outside H). Two neighbors differ in one element exactly when their missing h or added e agrees. Thus the flag link is the rook-graph clique complex, covered by row/column simplices with nerve K_{r,s}; its homotopy is a wedge of (r-1)(s-1) circles. Because the old flag complex is assumed simply connected, the link map is null and coning the link splits off exactly (r-1)(s-1) two-spheres. For the Fano and non-Fano matroids, reconstructed independent exhaustive simplicial enumeration, matching using actual recorded pivot permutations, and topological sorting of EVERY directed incidence reproduced respectively 322/384 nonempty faces, 784/977 Hasse incidences, 154/182 matched pairs, one critical vertex and 13/19 critical two-cells. Forman theory then yields the integral wedge homotopy types; a field-only Betti check is not the proof. The theorem explicitly does not cover nonsimply-connected old complexes.
